area: Internal app screens (RMM, 5 review departments, Customs, Legal, Business administrator, Auditor, Business owner): routes, nav, tabs, panels, actions, empty states, duplicates
summary:
I read every internal screen under /Users/thomas/Documents/Kissflow Projects/POC/Beiersdorf/prototype/src. That covers features/rmm (Dashboard, CaseList, NewCase, CaseDetail with 7 tabs, CaseActions, attention), features/review (ReviewQueue, ReviewWorkspace and every panel and modal, RMES, InformedList), features/admin (RuleTable with Rules/Simulator/Regression, Publish, TemplateManager with SectionDrawer and AddSection, OwnershipMatrix, ReminderSettings with EmailPreviews), features/reports (Reports with all cards, AuditTrail with EventLog and Reconstruct), layout (Shells, RoleSwitcher, Gates, AssumptionsDrawer), App.tsx routes and the PERSONAS nav in domain/catalog.ts. I checked them against the binding decisions (D-1..D-3, R-1, R-2, the AS answers of 12 Oct) and BRM v2 (02b).

The process logic of the screens is already right: no scope check, no overall approver, RMM review lane, matrix ending. Six groups of fixes remain:

**1. "Our understanding" is still in the app.** It sits in 4 persona navs (catalog.ts:341,358,399,427), on the /understanding route (App.tsx:71) and in the top-bar drawer (Shells.tsx:54-58,125).

**2. The v1 "review version" and document "vN" concept is still everywhere.** BRM v2 REQ-PROC-016 says there is no review version (02b:31), and documents are referenced by file name and upload date. The wording is in more than 25 places: CaseDetail, OverviewTab, AuditTab, DocumentsTab, WorkspaceHeader, CompletePanel, RMES, InformedList, EventLog and Reconstruct.

**3. Screens break or mislead with ZERO cases:**
- The Dashboard shows "0 days" and "0 %", and the bottleneck footer reads "Longest queue: RMM (0 in review)".
- The Reports takeaways read "0 completed and 0 started", and the value card reads "0 d to 0 d".
- The Audit log says "No event matches these filters".
- Reconstruct shows an empty select.
- The worst one: RegressionCheck/PublishModal replay hard-coded seeded case IDs (RegressionCheck.tsx:14). With no cases they report "Passed — 0 reference materials".

**4. Decided features with no screen yet:**
- AS-08: the raiser edits or closes their own open point. Today the only actions are accept, return and close-as-not-accepted, on answered points.
- R-1: an inbox per person, with one mail on raise, answer, edit and close.
- R-2/AS-12: an automatic on-screen final document with every thread. Today there is only a DemoNote at CaseDetail.tsx:240.
- The supplier master screen: view and add suppliers and contacts.
- Supplier personas built from the master contacts, so a newly added supplier can log in.

**5. Duplicates to cut:**
- InformedList is the same as All cases, because K7 and K8 are "Always".
- Reconstruct repeats the Case 360 tabs.
- The Scope tab repeats the "why in scope" information already in Questionnaire and the workspace.
- The Scope simulator and the Regression check overlap.
- The Business owner's "Operations" dashboard repeats the Reports KPIs and workload.
- The RMM Dashboard KPI tiles repeat the Reports tiles.

**6. Prototype-only widgets and stale assumption labels:**
- The sidebar "Ending:" box.
- DemoNotes for features that will now be real.
- AS-02, -06, -07 and -08 labels still marked "assumption" or "still open".
- Reset should go back to the empty start, not to the old seed.

Kept as is (after the changes): the Dashboard for RMM, All cases, New case, Case 360 (6 tabs plus Final document), My reviews, the review workspace (Questionnaire/RMES, open points, notes, completion), all four admin pages, Reports for the owner, and the Audit log for the auditor.

items.details:
On 'My open points' cards where createdBy === me and the case is open:
- **Edit** (modal): question, justification, due date (today or later), responsible. Allowed while status is 'open' (with the supplier). Once answered, the raiser uses Accept, Return or Close.
- **Close** (modal with a required reason): any non-closed status. Outcome 'withdrawn', shown as 'Closed by Beiersdorf'.
- Both add a thread message (edited: what changed; closed: the reason) and an audit event.
- Both update the supplier task (the portal view shows the new text, or the task disappears with 'closed by Beiersdorf').
- Each sends ONE mail (NEW-01).
- The track goes back to in-review when no point is left with the supplier (the same rule as reviewResponse, actions.ts:458).
- Accept, Return and Close-as-not-accepted (:41-101) stay and also send one mail each.
- Others see the cards read-only, with 'Only <raiser> can change this point'.

items.title: Edit or close timing against the supplier's answer
items.details: Edit is allowed only while status = open. If the supplier already answered (in-progress), the raiser decides with Accept, Return or Close-not-accepted, so the supplier's answer is never orphaned. Close (withdraw) is allowed in open and in-progress. Editing the due date to a later date clears 'overdue'. Rounds do not increase on edit. The thread and the final document show every edit. On a cancelled or completed case, both are hidden.

proposals:
**Final internal nav per role**

| Role | Landing | Nav items | Top bar |
|---|---|---|---|
| RMM | /rmm Dashboard | Dashboard · My reviews · All cases · New case · Suppliers | Inbox, theme, role switcher |
| Regulatory, Safety, QM, Microbiology, Sustainability | /review | My reviews · All cases | Inbox |
| Customs, Legal | /cases | All cases (read-only; Case 360 opens on K7 or K8) | Inbox |
| Business administrator | /admin/rules | Rule table · Questionnaire · Section owners · Reminders · Suppliers | Inbox (optional) |
| Auditor | /audit | Audit trail · All cases · Rule table (read-only) | none |
| Business owner | /reports | Reports · All cases | none |

Removed: "Our understanding" (nav, route, drawer), /informed, the Business owner's "Operations", and Reports for RMM.

**Final screens and tabs**

- **Dashboard** (RMM): 4 operational KPIs, Needs your action, Pipeline, Bottlenecks, My cases, Recent activity.
- **All cases**: tabs All open / Part 1 / Part 2 / Completed / Cancelled; filters supplier, department, waiting on, owner, overdue, origin; search incl. DUNS and CAS.
- **New case**, with "Add supplier" and a duplicate warning.
- **Suppliers**: list, detail with contacts, add.
- **Case 360**: tabs Overview · Questionnaire (incl. scope reasons and N.A. list) · Open points · Documents · Internal notes · History (incl. the reconstruction summary) · Final document (only once completed). Actions: RMM Cancel, Edit case, Open my review, Reactivate; reviewers get "Open review workspace".
- **My reviews**: To review / Waiting / Completed.
- **Review workspace**: header with Reassign; section nav with change markers; section content with Ask; tabs Questionnaire | RMES for Safety and Regulatory; Open points panel with Decide plus Edit/Close for the raiser; Internal notes; completion bar.
- **Admin**: Rule table (Rules · Test rules), Questionnaire versions (catalogue, drawer, real "add section to draft", Download JSON), Section owners, Reminders and notifications (events per R-1, static templates).
- **Reports**, with a "Pipeline now" section and empty states.
- **Audit trail**: Event log only.
- **Inbox**: list and reading pane.

**Data model sketch (domain/types.ts additions)**

- `Message.action` gains `"edited" | "withdrawn"`. `OpenPoint.outcome` already has "withdrawn". Add `OpenPoint.edits?: { at; by; field: "question" | "justification" | "dueDate" | "responsibleId"; from; to }[]`.
- New actions:
  - `editOpenPoint(s, by, caseId, opId, patch)`: guard `by === op.createdBy` and status open;
  - `closeOpenPoint(s, by, caseId, opId, reason)`: guard createdBy; status closed; outcome withdrawn; re-evaluate the track.
- `AppState.mails: Mail[]`, where `Mail = { id, at, kind: "invitation" | "op-raised" | "op-edited" | "op-returned" | "op-closed" | "op-accepted" | "op-answered" | "final-document" | "cancelled" | "reopened"; audience: "supplier" | "internal"; to: string[] (user ids); subject; body; caseId; openPointId?; readBy: string[] }`.
  - Mails are created inside the pure actions: raiseOpenPoint, supplierRespond, reviewResponse, edit, close, createCase, finalRelease, cancelCase and ensureTracks.
  - Store API: `markRead(mailId)`.
  - Supplier bodies come from a whitelist of fields only: material, case ID, reference label, due date, portal link.
- `CiqCase.finalDocument?: { generatedAt; caseId; facts; sections: { sectionId; answers; components? }[]; evidence: { name; sectionId; fieldId?; uploadedBy; uploadedAt }[]; threads: { opId; ref; rounds: Message[] }[]; confirmations: Confirmation[] }`.
  - Built in finalRelease() → complete(). It replaces the 'Generated final PDF' text-only audit row (actions.ts:557-562), which stays as an audit event.
- `Supplier` gains `active`, and contacts become first-class: `User.active?`. Store API: `addSupplier`, `updateSupplier`, `addContact`, `deactivateContact`, all audited (supplier-level audit list or a global admin audit).
- Personas: internal personas stay static. Supplier personas are derived at runtime from the contacts (`personaId = "sup:" + userId`, side supplier, landing /portal). PERSONA_BY_ID lookups must accept derived ids, and `load()` (store.tsx:33) must not discard state when a derived persona is active.
- Seed: `buildSeed()` returns the empty start. `buildDemoFixture()` (the current SPECS replay) moves to a fixture file used only by tests. Keep the supplier literal shape `{ id: "s1", name: "…" }` in seed.ts for scripts/harness-workbench-scenarios.mjs:99-103. Bump SCHEMA to 7.
- Regression: `REFERENCE_MATERIALS: { id; label; config; look }[]` lives in domain (shared by the simulator presets and the regression check) and replaces REFERENCE_CASES.
- Review assignee: `assigneeFor` defaults to the department's primary user (the persona user), so the demo persona holds the task. Add `reassignReview(s, by, caseId, dept, toUserId, reason)`.

**Duplicates resolved**

- InformedList → All cases.
- Reconstruct → Case 360 History.
- Scope tab → Questionnaire tab.
- Simulator plus Regression → Test rules.
- Owner Operations → Reports "Pipeline now".
- Dashboard lead-time and first-time-right tiles → Reports only.
- EmailPreviews (live data) → static templates plus Inbox.

Kept on purpose: Needs action vs My reviews; Case 360 Questionnaire/Notes vs the workspace panels (different roles and phases); Dashboard "My cases" widget vs All cases.

**Test plan:** TEST-01..04 run on top of the existing gate (`npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:portal && node scripts/harness-portal.mjs`). The browser e2e walks every persona from the empty start: RMM creates the case → supplier → reviews with open-point edit, close, answer and return → RMES rejection → release → final document → inbox counts per person. The workbench harness and src/workbench stay untouched.

**Open questions for Thomas (answer in the morning, or take the defaults)**

1. Who may add and edit suppliers: RMM only (plan F1), or RMM and the Business administrator? Default: both.
2. AS-08: does "the one who raised" mean only the raising person, or also the department colleague named responsible? Default: raiser only.
3. Answer mail recipients: the raiser only, or also the responsible person if different? Default: both, deduplicated.
4. Should Return, Accept and Close-not-accepted also each send one supplier mail? Default: yes; they are rounds of the same open point.
5. Do Customs, Legal and the Business owner write internal notes? Default: yes, except the Auditor (Workbench §8.15).
6. Should RMM keep Reports in the nav? Default: no, owner only.
7. Manual case completion by RMM when the supplier never releases (BRM REQ-PROC-045 "exceptional cases")? Default: not offered; cancel only.
8. Should the final document also be shown to the supplier in the portal? Default: no, internal only, because it contains the review-completion confirmations.
